# HUI+ (Hermes Interactive UI+)

> HUI+ is an unofficial, open-source chat app for Hermes Agent (Nous Research): approve commands, follow live tool steps, and answer with taps instead of typing. It talks only to a small bridge you run next to your own Hermes; there is no hosted service, no account and no telemetry. Not affiliated with Nous Research.

Current version: 0.3.1 (early release). Runs as an Android app (signed APK from GitHub Releases, or Obtainium), a web app (PWA served by your bridge), a macOS app (Apple Silicon, signed and notarized) and a Linux app (AppImage, .deb). iOS: use the web app; a native app is prepared for TestFlight. Not in the public app stores yet.

What it does:
- Approvals: see the exact command, its risk and deadline, then allow once, allow for the task, or deny.
- Live tool steps: a timeline of what ran and how long it took while the answer streams in.
- Interactive answers: 51 components, 25 of them interactive (checklists, choices, comparisons, forms, votes, rankings); each tap goes back to Hermes as the next message.
- Live cards: lists and plans that Hermes keeps up to date across messages, pinned in the chat.
- Local-first: chats stay on the device and on your own server.

Setup: on the machine that runs Hermes, turn on the Hermes API server, then run `npx hermes-ui-plus-bridge setup` (Node.js 22+ or Docker) and scan the pairing QR code in the app. Reach the bridge over Tailscale; do not expose it to the public internet.
